figurative_meaning_en: No direction or clue; aimless or without boundaries
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজের দিশপাশ নেই, সবাই হতবাক।
example_sentences_in_english: He has no direction in life.
This project has no clear direction, leaving everyone confused.
note: Commonly used to describe lack of focus or guidance in Bengali speech.
